title: Molecular Gas in the X-Ray Bright Group NGC 5044 as Revealed by ALMA
question: What are the mass, kinematics and confinement of the molecular gas in the cooling-flow group NGC 5044, and how does it relate to the hot gas, dust and AGN?

data.sensitivity: 4 sigma surface brightness limit 0.16 Jy/beam (in 50 km/s bins); mass limit 3e5 Msun

what.value: GMRT flux densities at 235 and 610 MHz (229 mJy and 39 mJy)

evidence.loc: The Central AGN and Absorption Feature
evidence.quote: the total flux densities (central point source plus extended emission) for 5044 at 235 MHz and 610 MHz from GMRT data are 229 mJy and 39 mJy (Giacintucci et al. 2008)

what.value: Star formation rate 0.073 Msun/yr from GALEX and WISE

evidence.quote: The star formation rate in NGC 5044 based on *GALEX* and *WISE* data is 0.073 M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ (Werner et al. 2014).
The cavity power in NGC 5044 is ${P_{cav}=6 \times 10^{42}}$ erg s$^{-1}$ (David et al. 2009)

recipe.method: Own continuum subtraction and channel maps with chosen velocity resolution and weighting
Bin cube into 50 km/s slices and identify structures above 4 sigma within the central 2.5 kpc where primary beam response >0.3

recipe.goal: Fit spectra and derive molecular masses
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to spectra in 10 km/s channels; mass from Bolatto et al. relation
assumptions: Xco = 2e20 cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1; CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) flux density ratio 3.2

recipe.goal: Size, density, virial parameter of resolved GMAs
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits to GMAs 11, 13, 18; deconvolved radius; surface and volume density; virial parameter
imfit point-source check, flux in line-free region, Gaussian fit to absorption in a 2x2 arcsec extraction

evidence.quote: detected 24 molecular structures within the central 2.5 kpc
The total molecular mass of the GMAs listed in Table 1 is $5.1 \times 10^7$ M$_{\odot}$
the average GMC volume filling factor for the three GMAs is 15%

answer_key.quantity: Central AGN flux density at 230 GHz

evidence.loc: The Central AGN and Absorption Feature
The Central AGN and Absorption Feature
evidence.quote: a mean velocity of $260.3 \pm 0.8$ km s$^{-1}$ and a linewidth of $5.2 \pm 0.8$ km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Weighting scheme / robust value and tclean/clean parameters for the cubes
Line-free channels or fit order used for continuum subtraction
How the 24 structures were delineated and spectral extraction apertures
Derivation of GMC density and pressure estimates and X-ray gas values
score_reason: Public data and simple analysis, but imaging and region definitions are unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Data public, a single short execution, and numeric results (masses, linewidths, flux density) are tabulated, though imaging details need reconstruction.
